data.title: 生盐诺亚 · 雨窗晨光的真丝侧影
data.description: 清晨的细雨在落地窗上织出连绵的水珠。诺亚赤着双足站在窗前，纤薄的真丝睡裙勾勒出曼妙窈窕的身段。她单手轻按在微凉的玻璃上，白发在晨光微澜中散发着温润的光泽。转眸回望的瞬间，从容知性的书记官眼角泛着毫无戒备的娇柔笑意。
data.location: modern apartment bedroom by rainy floor-to-ceiling glass window
data.action: standing barefoot by rain-streaked window, touching glass with fingertips, purple silk nightdress hugging figure, turning with delicate affectionate smile
data.lighting: diffused cool rainy morning light outlining feminine silhouette
data.mood: poetic morning quietude, alluring delicate elegance
data.promptProse: Standing barefoot beside a rain-streaked glass window in the early morning, Ushio Noa wears a fitted silk slip dress. Soft daylight outlines her slender silhouette as she turns with a serene, loving expression.
data.animaCaption: Noa standing barefoot beside a rainy window in a sleek silk slip dress, looking back warmly.
